name: aiutodoc-clinical-validation
description: Suite Playwright isolata per la validazione clinico-funzionale di AIutoDoc

scripts.test:staging: npm run guard && cross-env AIUTODOC_ENV=staging playwright test
scripts.test:staging:local: npm run guard && cross-env AIUTODOC_ENV=staging AIUTODOC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4273 playwright test --grep "ANEMIA_01|ANEMIA_02|CELIACHIA_02|COVID_01|COVID_02|INFLUENZA_02"
scripts.test:validator: npm run guard && cross-env AIUTODOC_ENV=staging AIUTODOC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4273 playwright test tests/anamnesis-routing-validator.spec.ts --project=chromium-desktop
scripts.test:live: npm run guard && cross-env AIUTODOC_ENV=live AIUTODOC_BASE_URL=https://aiutodoc.it playwright test --grep "ANEMIA_01|ANEMIA_02|CELIACHIA_02|COVID_01|COVID_02|INFLUENZA_02"
scripts.test:live:all: npm run guard && cross-env AIUTODOC_ENV=live AIUTODOC_BASE_URL=https://aiutodoc.it playwright test
